references.text: Mentions Peres as one of Judah's sons and a descendant of Jacob who went to Egypt.
Peres is mentioned as the ancestor of the Perezites among the descendants of Judah.
Peres is explicitly named as the son of Tamar and Judah, with the wish that the house may be like the house of Peres.
The genealogy of Peres leading from Peres to David.
Tamar bore Peres and Zerah to Judah – a direct parallel to the birth narrative.
Peres is mentioned in Jesus' genealogy in Matthew as the son of Judah and Tamar.
Peres is mentioned in Jesus' genealogy in Luke.
Both verses use 'breaking through' (Perezim) as a theological image of God's unexpected intervention and victory.
